---
title: ROS2 interface
description: Node reference, topic interface, system architecture, and TF tree
---

## Node reference

| Node | Package | Description |
|------|---------|-------------|
| `manus_data_publisher` | manus_ros2 | MANUS Glove C++ driver, publishes raw data |
| `manus_input` | manus_input_py | MANUS data processor, converts to MediaPipe format |
| `openvr_input` | openvr_input | HTC Vive Tracker data collection |
| `pico_input_node` | pico_input | PICO VR hand and wrist tracking |
| `wujihand_controller` | controller | Wuji Hand control node |
| `tianji_arm_controller` | controller | Tianji Arm control node |

## Topic interface

| Topic | Type | Publisher | Description |
|-------|------|-----------|-------------|
| `/hand_input` | `Float32MultiArray` | manus_input, pico_input | MediaPipe hand keypoints (63 values per hand, 126 = 2 x 21 x 3 for both) |
| `/manus_glove_<n>` | `ManusGlove` | manus_data_publisher | MANUS raw data (index assigned by connection order; check the `side_id` field in the message to determine left/right) |
| `/tf` | `TFMessage` | openvr_input, pico_input_node | TF transforms (published internally by input device nodes) |

## System architecture

```text
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                        Input Devices                            │
│  ┌──────────┐   ┌──────────────┐   ┌──────────┐                │
│  │  MANUS   │   │ HTC Vive     │   │  PICO    │                │
│  │  Glove   │   │ Tracker      │   │  VR      │                │
│  └────┬─────┘   └──────┬───────┘   └────┬─────┘                │
└───────┼────────────────┼────────────────┼───────────────────────┘
        │                │                │
        ▼                ▼                ▼
┌──────────────┐ ┌──────────────┐ ┌──────────────┐
│ manus_input  │ │ openvr_input │ │  pico_input  │
│ (hand data)  │ │ (TF data)    │ │ (hand + TF)  │
└──────┬───────┘ └──────┬───────┘ └──────┬───────┘
       │                │                │
       ▼                ▼                ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│            Standard Topic Interface              │
│  /hand_input (keypoints)    /tf (transforms)     │
└──────────┬──────────────────────┬────────────────┘
           │                     │
           ▼                     ▼
   ┌──────────────┐     ┌──────────────────┐
   │ wujihand_ik  │     │  tianji_output   │
   │ (retarget)   │     │  (TF query → IK) │
   └──────┬───────┘     └──────┬───────────┘
          │                    │
          ▼                    ▼
   ┌──────────────┐     ┌──────────────┐
   │  Wuji Hand   │     │  Tianji Arm  │
   │  (hardware)  │     │  (hardware)  │
   └──────────────┘     └──────────────┘
```
